_comment: Mooncalves are shy to the point of only surfacing at the full moon, so the bond is slow and food-led. A bonded one keeps producing the dung its crop-growth use depends on, which was previously a kill-only drop.
_breedingComment: A herd is the point. Mooncalf dung is the mod's fertiliser and a single bonded mooncalf gives it slowly; two give you a herd that keeps giving. Wheat is both the feed and the breeding item, so raising them is one loop rather than two.
